faqs.q: How do I apply for a driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a driving instructor licence using the dedicated application link.

faqs.q: What if I need to renew my driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your driving instructor licence through the renewal service.

faqs.q: Where can I find information about riding instructor licences?
faqs.a: The page provides options to apply for a riding instructor licence or a restricted riding instructor licence.

faqs.q: What are the common questions regarding driving, riding, and bus driver authority?
faqs.a: Common questions are available regarding the driving/riding instructor and bus driver authority.
